showcase_toolchain.golden_command:
DIALECTS_ROOT=$(pwd)
GOLDEN_WORKDIR=${GOLDEN_WORKDIR:?}
export ROOTFORM_HOME=$GOLDEN_WORKDIR/home
mkdir -p $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/vendor-$(date +%s); V=$(ls -d $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/vendor-* | tail -1)
for d in $(python3 -c "import json;print(' '.join(x['name'] for x in json.load(open('$DIALECTS_ROOT/dialects.json'))['dialects']))"); do cp -R $DIALECTS_ROOT/$d $V/$d; done
mkdir -p $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/fx/<name>/.rootform && cp $DIALECTS_ROOT/fixtures/slice/<name>/*.tf $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/fx/<name>/ && cp -R $V $GOLDEN_WORKDIR/fx/<name>/.rootform/dialects
cd $GOLDEN_WORKDIR && { $ROOTFORM_BIN build fx/<name> --offline --no-input; printf '\n'; } > $DIALECTS_ROOT/fixtures/slice/<name>/architecture.golden
